finalMessage:
I added the three Claude 5.5 models to `src/prices.js` and added a test that costs one request on each. `npm test` passes: 17 of 17, up from 16.

**Prices.** I took these from Anthropic's pricing page (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing) and checked them against https://claude.com/pricing. Both give the same numbers, and neither mentions any price change still to come for these models.

| Model | input | output | cacheRead | cacheWrite (5 min) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| claude-haiku-5-5 (prompts up to 100,000 tokens) | 0.10 | 0.50 | 0.01 | 0.125 |
| claude-sonnet-5-5 | 2 | 10 | 0.10 | 2.50 |
| claude-opus-5-5 | 4 | 20 | 0.20 | 5 |

A few of these differ from what you might expect, which is probably the recent change you mentioned. Third-party blogs disagree on them, which is why I only used the official pages:
- **Opus 5.5 is cheaper than Opus 5:** $4/$20 against $5/$25.
- **Cheaper cache reads:** on Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, cache reads cost 5% of the input price instead of the usual 10%.
- **Haiku 5.5** is about 90% cheaper than Haiku 4.5 for prompts up to 100,000 tokens.

**The changes:**
- **`src/prices.js`:** three new entries, a comment with the source URL, and the "Last updated" line now reads `2026-10-13, adding the Claude 5.5 models.` I dated it the 13th to match your request; I checked the pages today, the 14th. The existing entries are unchanged: the diff removes only the old "Last updated" line.
- **`test/cost.test.js`:** a new test, `costOf prices the Claude 5.5 models`, costs the same request on each of the three models.

**One limitation:** Haiku 5.5 charges about five times more when a prompt is over 100,000 tokens, counting cache reads and writes. The price table only has one price per model, so those requests will be undercharged. I left a comment next to the entry saying so. Handling this properly would need `costOf` to choose the price based on the prompt's size.

I haven't committed anything.
